title: William Blake &  Buckminster Fuller: Lives in Juxtaposition (A study in Comprehensivity)

creators.name: Friedman, Daniel Ari
creators.affiliation: University of California (Davis), Active Inference Institute

description: Slides for a presentation, initially for 52 Living Ideas on January 8th 2023 at 6pm PT.  This is a work in progress, presented for educational and collaborative reasons.   Watch on YouTube:  https://youtu.be/JGI0vx_aBdM

methods.name: Slide-by-slide juxtaposition of Blake and Fuller images and texts
methods.description: Each slide places images and texts related to Blake alongside those related to Fuller to surface concordances, points of contact and provocative connections.

methods.name: Quotation of primary sources (Blake's plates; Fuller's Synergetics)
methods.description: Quotes primary texts such as Jerusalem and The Marriage of Heaven and Hell for Blake and numbered Synergetics passages for Fuller.
methods.evidence: Marriage of Heaven and Hell, Plate 3 Without Contraries is no progression. Attraction and Repulsion, Reason and Energy, Love and Hate, are necessary to Human existence.

key_findings: The author concludes there are complex similarities, divergences and resonances between Blake and Fuller, open to multiple perspectives.
The deck proposes both used logical paradigms distinguishing Negation (not-A) from Contradiction (complement-to-A).
The deck suggests both find resonance with modern trends including 4EA cognitive science and Active Inference.
key_findings_evidence: There are complex and rewarding similarities, divergences, and resonances. ●There are multiple possible perspectives to take on this juxtaposition.
Used logical paradigms which distinguish between Negation (not-A) and Contradiction (complement-to-A)
Both find resonance with modern trends towards… ● Agential realism (Barad et al.) ● Embodied, Embedded, Enacted, Extended, Affective (4EA) cognitive science

abstract: A presentation for '52 Living Ideas' comparing the lives and works of William Blake and Buckminster Fuller in juxtaposition. The study in comprehensivity explores structural parallels between Blake's prophetic vision and Fuller's design science, identifying convergences in their approaches to creativity, systems thinking, and human potential. Both figures challenged conventional boundaries between disciplines and proposed integrative frameworks for understanding reality.
